title: Winter Is Coming to Northern Taiwan
s: The weather is getting colder in northern Taiwan.
北台灣的天氣越來越冷了。
Experts expect temperatures to drop over the next few days.
專家預計接下來幾天氣溫會下降。
Cold weather is also the start of flu season.
天氣變冷也代表流感季開始了。
Taiwan's CDC plans to buy nearly 500,000 more vaccine doses.
台灣疾管署計畫再採購將近五十萬劑疫苗。
Wear a jacket, wash your hands, and get enough sleep.
記得穿外套、勤洗手、睡飽一點。

title: Fast Hands, Many Golds
s: Have you ever tried sport stacking?
你玩過競技疊杯嗎？
Players stack and unstack plastic cups as fast as they can.
選手要用最快速度把塑膠杯疊起來再收下。
Taiwan won 48 gold medals at the Asian Sport Stacking Championships.
台灣在亞洲競技疊杯錦標賽贏得 48 面金牌。
The sport trains your focus and your hand speed.
這項運動能訓練專注力和手速。
All you need to start is a set of cups and some practice.
只要一組杯子加上練習就能開始。

title: Catch the Train at the Last Minute
s: Taiwan Railway has changed its online booking rules.
台鐵調整了線上訂票規定。
The online booking cutoff is now just five minutes before departure.
線上訂票的截止時間縮短到發車前五分鐘。
This makes last-minute trips much easier.
這讓臨時出門方便多了。
Still, it is smart to plan ahead on busy weekends.
不過遇到熱門週末，還是提早計畫比較聰明。
Where would you go if you had a free day?
如果你有一天空閒，會想去哪裡？

title: AI Helps Taiwan's Exports Grow
titleZh: AI 帶動台灣出口成長
s: Taiwan's exports reached a record high in October.
台灣十月的出口創下新高。
They jumped by nearly 60 percent compared with last year.
和去年相比大增將近六成。
The main reason is the global demand for AI technology.
主要原因是全球對 AI 科技的需求。
Many AI servers and chips are made in Taiwan.
許多 AI 伺服器和晶片都是台灣製造的。
Learning about technology could open doors for your future.
了解科技可能為你的未來打開更多機會。

title: Stay Safe Online
s: Hackers are now using AI to attack companies.
駭客現在會利用 AI 攻擊企業。
Nearly half of recent cyberattacks on Taiwan firms were linked to AI.
近期針對台灣企業的網路攻擊，將近一半與 AI 有關。
Fake messages and emails can look very real.
假訊息和假郵件可能看起來非常逼真。
Never click a strange link or share your password.
千萬不要點奇怪的連結，也不要分享密碼。
When in doubt, ask a parent or teacher first.
有疑慮時，先問問爸媽或老師。

title: Penguins Take a Walk
s: Today is a special day at Taipei Zoo.
今天是台北市立動物園的特別日子。
The zoo is letting its penguins waddle outside.
動物園讓企鵝到戶外搖搖擺擺地走一走。
Penguins cannot fly, but they are excellent swimmers.
企鵝不會飛，但很會游泳。
Visitors can watch them walk in their funny, careful way.
遊客可以看牠們用逗趣又小心的方式走路。
Which animal would you most like to see up close?
你最想近距離看哪種動物？

title: Tiny Pieces of History
s: The Taipei World Stamp Exhibition opens today.
台北世界郵展今天開幕。
It is called PHILATAIPEI 2026.
這個展覽叫做 PHILATAIPEI 2026。
Visitors can see rare stamps and old postal objects.
參觀者可以看到珍貴郵票和早期郵政文物。
Each stamp tells a small story about a place and its time.
每張郵票都訴說著一個地方和時代的小故事。
When was the last time you sent a real letter?
你上一次寄出真正的信是什麼時候？

title: Why We Need Sleep
s: Sleep is not a waste of time.
睡覺不是浪費時間。
While we sleep, our brain sorts what we learned that day.
我們睡覺時，大腦會整理當天學到的東西。
Teenagers need about eight to ten hours of sleep.
青少年大約需要八到十小時的睡眠。
Putting your phone away before bed can help you sleep better.
睡前把手機收起來能幫助你睡得更好。

title: The Magic of Bubble Tea
s: Bubble tea was created in Taiwan in the 1980s.
珍珠奶茶在 1980 年代於台灣誕生。
Today, people enjoy it all over the world.
如今全世界的人都愛喝。
The chewy balls are made from tapioca.
那些Q彈的珍珠是用木薯粉做的。
Try ordering less sugar to make it healthier.
試著點少糖，讓它更健康。

title: Walking Is a Superpower
s: Walking is one of the easiest ways to stay healthy.
走路是保持健康最簡單的方法之一。
It is free, and you can do it almost anywhere.
它不用錢，而且幾乎在哪裡都能做。
A short walk can also clear your mind.
短短散個步也能讓頭腦清醒。
Why not walk to the station instead of taking a scooter?
何不走路去車站，不要騎機車？

title: Octopuses Are Smart
s: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood.
章魚有三顆心臟和藍色的血液。
It can change its color to hide from enemies.
牠能改變顏色來躲避敵人。
Some octopuses can even open jars to get food.
有些章魚甚至會打開罐子拿食物。
Scientists think they are among the smartest sea animals.
科學家認為牠們是最聰明的海洋動物之一。

title: Saying Thank You
s: Saying thank you is a small habit with a big effect.
說謝謝是個小習慣，卻有大影響。
It makes other people feel noticed and valued.
它讓別人覺得被看見、被重視。
Studies show that grateful people are often happier.
研究顯示，懂得感恩的人通常比較快樂。
Who will you thank today?
你今天要感謝誰？

title: Thanksgiving in America
s: Today is Thanksgiving Day in the United States.
今天是美國的感恩節。
Families gather to share a big meal together.
家人們團聚，一起享用豐盛的大餐。
Turkey and pumpkin pie are traditional dishes.
火雞和南瓜派是傳統菜色。
People also take time to think about what they are thankful for.
人們也會花時間想想自己感謝的事。

title: Learning from Mistakes
s: Everyone makes mistakes, even experts.
每個人都會犯錯，連專家也是。
A mistake shows you what to try differently next time.
錯誤會告訴你下次該換什麼方法。
Instead of hiding mistakes, talk about them.
與其隱藏錯誤，不如把它說出來。
That is how real learning happens.
真正的學習就是這樣發生的。

title: Taiwan's Mountains
s: Taiwan has more than two hundred mountains over 3,000 meters.
台灣有兩百多座超過三千公尺的高山。
Yushan, or Jade Mountain, is the highest in Northeast Asia.
玉山是東北亞最高峰。
Many hikers dream of reaching its peak.
許多登山客夢想登上山頂。
Always check the weather before you go hiking.
去爬山前一定要先查天氣。

title: Why Is the Sky Blue?
s: Sunlight is made of many colors.
陽光是由許多顏色組成的。
When it hits the air, blue light spreads out the most.
陽光碰到空氣時，藍光散射得最多。
That is why we see a blue sky during the day.
所以我們白天看到藍色的天空。
At sunset, the light travels farther, so the sky turns orange.
日落時光線走得更遠，天空就變成橘色。

title: Goodbye, November
s: November is almost over.
十一月快結束了。
It's a good time to look back on what you have done this month.
這是回顧本月成果的好時機。
Did you learn something new?
你學到新東西了嗎？
Set one small goal for December.
為十二月定一個小目標吧。

title: Hello, December
s: December is the last month of the year.
十二月是一年的最後一個月。
In many countries, streets are full of holiday lights.
在許多國家，街道都掛滿了節日燈飾。
It's also a busy month for exams in Taiwan.
在台灣，這也是考試很多的月份。
Plan your time well and take care of yourself.
好好規劃時間，照顧自己。

title: The Power of Music
s: Music can change how we feel in seconds.
音樂能在幾秒內改變我們的心情。
Fast songs give us energy, and slow songs help us relax.
快歌給我們能量，慢歌幫我們放鬆。
Some students listen to music while studying.
有些學生邊聽音樂邊讀書。
Songs without lyrics are often better for focus.
沒有歌詞的音樂通常比較能專心。

title: Everyone Belongs
s: Today is the International Day of Persons with Disabilities.
今天是國際身心障礙者日。
People with disabilities have the same dreams as everyone else.
身心障礙者和大家有一樣的夢想。
Ramps, elevators, and captions help everyone take part.
斜坡、電梯和字幕讓每個人都能參與。
A kind attitude is the first step to an inclusive society.
友善的態度是共融社會的第一步。

title: Cats or Dogs?
s: Some people love cats, and others love dogs.
有人愛貓，有人愛狗。
Cats are often calm and independent.
貓通常冷靜又獨立。
Dogs are usually friendly and love to play.
狗通常友善又愛玩。
Either way, a pet is a big responsibility.
不論哪一種，養寵物都是很大的責任。

title: Volunteers Make a Difference
s: Today is International Volunteer Day.
今天是國際志工日。
Volunteers give their time to help others without pay.
志工無償付出時間幫助他人。
You can volunteer at libraries, parks, or animal shelters.
你可以到圖書館、公園或動物收容所當志工。
Helping others also helps you grow.
幫助別人也能讓自己成長。

title: The Moon Is Moving Away
s: The moon moves about four centimeters away from Earth every year.
月球每年遠離地球約四公分。
That is about as fast as your fingernails grow.
這大約和指甲生長的速度一樣。
Millions of years ago, the moon looked bigger in the sky.
幾百萬年前，月亮在天空中看起來更大。
But don't worry, it won't disappear anytime soon.
不過別擔心，它不會很快消失。

title: Night Markets
s: Night markets are a big part of life in Taiwan.
夜市是台灣生活很重要的一部分。
You can find snacks, games, and cheap clothes there.
在那裡可以找到小吃、遊戲和便宜衣服。
Popular snacks include fried chicken and oyster omelets.
熱門小吃有炸雞和蚵仔煎。
Remember to bring a reusable bag.
記得帶環保袋。

title: Reading Every Day
s: Reading just fifteen minutes a day adds up quickly.
每天只讀十五分鐘，累積起來很可觀。
That's more than ninety hours in a year.
一年就超過九十個小時。
You can read comics, novels, or news.
你可以讀漫畫、小說或新聞。
The best book is the one you actually enjoy.
最好的書，就是你真正喜歡的那本。

title: Phone Breaks
s: Many teens check their phones over a hundred times a day.
很多青少年一天看手機超過一百次。
Constant notifications make it hard to focus.
不斷跳出的通知讓人難以專心。
Try turning off notifications while you study.
讀書時試著關掉通知。
You may be surprised how much you get done.
你可能會驚訝自己完成了多少事。

title: Human Rights Day
s: Today is Human Rights Day.
今天是人權日。
Human rights belong to every person, everywhere.
人權屬於每個人，不分地方。
They include the right to learn and to speak freely.
人權包括受教育和自由表達的權利。
Respecting others is how we protect these rights.
尊重他人，就是在守護這些權利。

title: Mountains Matter
s: Today is International Mountain Day.
今天是國際山岳日。
Mountains provide fresh water for billions of people.
高山為數十億人提供淡水。
They are also home to many plants and animals.
它們也是許多動植物的家。
Leave no trash behind when you visit them.
上山時不要留下任何垃圾。

title: Exam Season Tips
s: Exam season can feel stressful.
考試季可能讓人壓力很大。
Break big topics into small parts.
把大範圍拆成小部分。
Test yourself instead of just reading notes again.
自我測驗，而不是只重讀筆記。
And don't forget to eat well and sleep enough.
還有別忘了好好吃飯、睡飽。

title: The Smallest Bird
s: The bee hummingbird is the smallest bird in the world.
吸蜜蜂鳥是世界上最小的鳥。
It is only about five centimeters long.
牠只有大約五公分長。
Its wings can beat around eighty times per second.
牠的翅膀每秒可以拍動約八十次。
It lives in Cuba and drinks nectar from flowers.
牠住在古巴，以花蜜為食。

title: Be Kind Online
s: Words online can hurt just like words in person.
網路上的話和當面說的話一樣傷人。
Before you post, ask yourself if it is kind.
發文前，先問自己這樣友善嗎？
If someone is being bullied, don't join in.
如果有人被霸凌，不要跟著起鬨。
Support them and tell a trusted adult.
支持他們，並告訴信任的大人。

title: Tea Culture in Taiwan
s: Taiwan is famous for its oolong tea.
台灣以烏龍茶聞名。
Tea farms cover the hills of Alishan and Pinglin.
阿里山和坪林的山坡上都是茶園。
Drinking tea with family is a common tradition.
和家人一起喝茶是常見的傳統。
What's your favorite kind of tea?
你最喜歡哪一種茶？

title: How Plants Eat
s: Plants make their own food using sunlight.
植物利用陽光自己製造養分。
This process is called photosynthesis.
這個過程叫做光合作用。
Plants take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen.
植物吸入二氧化碳，釋放氧氣。
So every breath you take depends on plants.
所以你的每一口呼吸都靠植物。

title: Making Friends
s: Making new friends can feel a little scary.
交新朋友可能會有點緊張。
Start with a simple question or a smile.
從一個簡單的問題或微笑開始。
People like those who listen to them.
人們喜歡願意聽他們說話的人。
Good friendships take time to grow.
好的友誼需要時間培養。

title: Snow Around the World
s: Snow falls in many countries during winter.
許多國家冬天會下雪。
In Taiwan, snow only falls on very high mountains.
在台灣，只有很高的山上才會下雪。
Every snowflake has six sides.
每片雪花都有六個邊。
Have you ever seen real snow?
你看過真正的雪嗎？

title: Saving Money
s: Saving money is easier when you have a goal.
有目標時，存錢會比較容易。
Write down what you want to buy and how much it costs.
寫下你想買什麼、要多少錢。
Put a little aside every week.
每週存一點。
Small amounts grow into big savings over time.
小錢日積月累會變成一大筆存款。

title: Winter Break Is Coming
s: Winter break is not far away.
寒假不遠了。
It's a great chance to try a new hobby.
這是嘗試新嗜好的好機會。
You could learn to cook, draw, or play an instrument.
你可以學煮飯、畫畫或玩樂器。
What will you do with your free time?
你會怎麼運用空閒時間？

title: The Longest Night
s: Around this time, nights are the longest of the year.
大約在這段時間，夜晚是一年中最長的。
Ancient people noticed this and held festivals.
古時候的人注意到了，並舉辦慶典。
After this, the days slowly get longer again.
在這之後，白天又會慢慢變長。
It reminds us that light always returns.
它提醒我們，光明總會回來。

title: Winter Solstice and Tangyuan
s: Today is the Winter Solstice, or Dongzhi.
今天是冬至。
Many families in Taiwan eat tangyuan on this day.
台灣很多家庭會在這天吃湯圓。
These round rice balls stand for family unity.
圓圓的湯圓象徵家人團圓。
Some people say eating them makes you one year older.
有人說吃了湯圓就長一歲。

title: Gift Giving
s: Giving gifts is a way to show care.
送禮是表達關心的方式。
A gift doesn't have to be expensive.
禮物不必很貴。
A handwritten card can mean a lot.
一張手寫卡片可能意義重大。
The thought behind it matters most.
最重要的是背後的心意。

title: Christmas Eve
s: Tonight is Christmas Eve.
今晚是平安夜。
In many countries, families share a special dinner.
在許多國家，家人會一起吃特別的晚餐。
Children hang stockings and wait for Santa Claus.
孩子們掛上襪子，等待聖誕老人。
Many cities in Taiwan also light up big Christmas trees.
台灣許多城市也會點亮大型聖誕樹。

title: Merry Christmas!
s: Today is Christmas Day.
今天是聖誕節。
People exchange gifts and spend time with loved ones.
人們交換禮物，和所愛的人相聚。
Popular songs and bright decorations fill the streets.
熱門歌曲和明亮裝飾布滿街道。
However you celebrate, enjoy the warm feeling of the season.
無論怎麼慶祝，都好好享受這季節的溫暖。

title: After the Holidays
s: Many shops have big sales after Christmas.
聖誕節後，許多商店會大打折。
It's tempting to buy things you don't need.
很容易忍不住買不需要的東西。
Ask yourself: Will I really use this?
問問自己：我真的會用到嗎？
Smart shoppers think before they buy.
聰明的消費者會先想再買。

title: Looking Back on the Year
s: The year is almost over.
這一年快結束了。
Take a moment to think about your best memories.
花點時間想想你最美好的回憶。
What challenges did you overcome?
你克服了哪些挑戰？
Be proud of how far you have come.
為自己走了這麼遠感到驕傲。

title: Keeping a Journal
s: Writing a journal helps you understand your feelings.
寫日記能幫助你了解自己的感受。
You don't need to write a lot.
你不需要寫很多。
Just three sentences a day is enough.
一天三句就夠了。
Try writing yours in English for extra practice.
試著用英文寫，順便多練習。

title: New Year's Resolutions
s: Many people make resolutions for the new year.
很多人會為新的一年許下新希望。
Common ones are to exercise more or read more.
常見的有多運動或多閱讀。
Specific goals are easier to keep.
具體的目標比較容易做到。
"Read one book a month" is better than "read more."
「每月讀一本書」比「多讀書」更好。

title: Fireworks Science
s: Fireworks get their colors from different metals.
煙火的顏色來自不同的金屬。
Copper makes blue, and sodium makes yellow.
銅產生藍色，鈉產生黃色。
Red often comes from a metal called strontium.
紅色通常來自一種叫鍶的金屬。
Tomorrow night, look up and guess the metals!
明晚抬頭看看，猜猜是哪些金屬！

title: New Year's Eve
s: Tonight is New Year's Eve.
今晚是跨年夜。
Thousands of people gather near Taipei 101 to count down.
成千上萬的人聚集在台北 101 附近倒數。
Fireworks will light up the sky at midnight.
午夜時煙火會照亮天空。
Goodbye to the old year, and welcome the new one!
再見舊的一年，迎接新的一年！

title: Happy New Year!
s: Happy New Year 2027!
2027 新年快樂！
January 1st is also the Founding Day of the Republic of China.
一月一日也是中華民國開國紀念日。
A flag-raising ceremony is held in front of the Presidential Office.
總統府前會舉行升旗典禮。
A new year is a fresh start for everyone.
新的一年是每個人的新開始。

title: Start Small
s: Big changes start with small steps.
大改變從小步驟開始。
Want to read more? Start with one page a day.
想多閱讀？從一天一頁開始。
Want to exercise? Start with five minutes.
想運動？從五分鐘開始。
Small wins build confidence.
小小的成功能建立自信。

title: The Coldest Month
s: January is usually the coldest month in Taiwan.
一月通常是台灣最冷的月份。
Cold air from the north can bring temperatures below ten degrees.
北方冷空氣可能讓氣溫降到十度以下。
Keep warm and drink hot water.
注意保暖，多喝溫水。
Check on older family members, too.
也要關心家裡的長輩。

title: Robots Around Us
s: Robots are no longer just in movies.
機器人不再只出現在電影裡。
Some restaurants use robots to serve food.
有些餐廳用機器人送餐。
Robot vacuums clean floors in many homes.
掃地機器人在許多家庭清潔地板。
What job would you like a robot to do for you?
你希望機器人幫你做什麼工作？

title: Drink More Water
s: Your body is about sixty percent water.
你的身體大約有六成是水。
Even mild thirst can make you feel tired.
即使只是有點口渴，也會讓你覺得累。
Carry a water bottle to school.
帶水壺去學校。
Water is better than sugary drinks.
喝水比喝含糖飲料好。

title: Penguins in Love
s: Some penguins stay with the same partner for many years.
有些企鵝會跟同一個伴侶在一起很多年。
Gentoo penguins give their partners small stones.
巴布亞企鵝會送伴侶小石頭。
They use the stones to build nests.
牠們用石頭築巢。
It's like a penguin's way of giving a gift.
這就像企鵝送禮的方式。

title: Taking Notes
s: Good notes help you remember what you learn.
好筆記能幫你記住學過的東西。
Don't copy everything the teacher says.
不要把老師說的每句話都抄下來。
Write key words and draw simple diagrams.
寫下關鍵字，畫簡單的圖表。
Review your notes the same day.
當天就複習筆記。

title: Earthquake Safety
s: Taiwan has many earthquakes every year.
台灣每年有很多地震。
When the ground shakes, drop, cover, and hold on.
地面搖晃時，要趴下、掩護、穩住。
Stay away from windows and heavy objects.
遠離窗戶和重物。
Prepare an emergency bag at home.
在家準備一個緊急避難包。

title: The Ocean Is Huge
s: Oceans cover more than seventy percent of Earth.
海洋覆蓋地球七成以上的面積。
More than eighty percent of the ocean has never been explored.
超過八成的海洋從未被探索過。
Scientists find new sea creatures every year.
科學家每年都會發現新的海洋生物。
The deep sea is still full of mysteries.
深海仍充滿謎團。

title: Learning a New Language
s: Learning a language opens doors to new cultures.
學語言能打開通往新文化的大門。
Mistakes are a normal part of the process.
犯錯是過程中很正常的一部分。
Watch shows, sing songs, and talk to people.
看節目、唱歌、跟人聊天。
A little every day works better than a lot once a week.
每天一點點，比一週一次學很多更有效。

title: Sharing Is Caring
s: Sharing doesn't only mean giving things.
分享不只是送東西。
You can share your time, ideas, or a smile.
你也可以分享時間、想法或微笑。
When we share, we build stronger communities.
當我們分享，就能建立更緊密的社群。
What can you share with someone today?
今天你可以跟誰分享什麼？

title: Bicycles in Taiwan
s: Taiwan is known as a kingdom of bicycles.
台灣被稱為自行車王國。
Many top bike brands come from Taiwan.
許多頂級自行車品牌來自台灣。
YouBike makes it easy to ride around cities.
YouBike 讓人在城市裡騎車很方便。
Riding a bike is healthy and good for the environment.
騎腳踏車既健康又環保。

title: Your Amazing Brain
s: Your brain has about eighty-six billion nerve cells.
你的大腦大約有八百六十億個神經細胞。
It uses about twenty percent of your body's energy.
它使用身體約兩成的能量。
Learning new things creates new connections in the brain.
學習新事物會在大腦中建立新連結。
So every lesson literally changes your brain!
所以每一堂課都真的在改變你的大腦！

title: Healthy Snacks
s: Snacks can give you energy between meals.
點心能在兩餐之間補充能量。
Fruit, nuts, and yogurt are good choices.
水果、堅果和優格是不錯的選擇。
Chips and candy are fine sometimes, but not every day.
洋芋片和糖果偶爾可以，但不要天天吃。
Read the label to check how much sugar is inside.
看看標示，確認含糖量多少。

title: Old Streets of Taiwan
s: Old streets show what Taiwan looked like long ago.
老街呈現台灣很久以前的樣貌。
Jiufen, Lukang, and Daxi are famous examples.
九份、鹿港和大溪都是有名的例子。
You can try traditional snacks and see old buildings.
你可以吃傳統小吃、看老建築。
They are like living history books.
它們就像活的歷史課本。

title: Asking for Help
s: Asking for help is a sign of strength.
開口求助是堅強的表現。
Nobody can do everything alone.
沒有人能獨自完成所有事。
Teachers and friends are usually happy to help.
老師和朋友通常都很樂意幫忙。
Try saying, "Could you explain this again?"
試著說：「你可以再解釋一次嗎？」

title: Why Cats Purr
s: Cats often purr when they feel happy and relaxed.
貓開心放鬆時常會發出呼嚕聲。
But they also purr when they are sick or scared.
但牠們生病或害怕時也會呼嚕。
Scientists think purring may help cats heal.
科學家認為呼嚕可能幫助貓咪復原。
It's one of the many mysteries of cats.
這是貓咪眾多謎團之一。

title: Final Exams
s: Final exams are coming soon.
期末考快到了。
Make a study plan and stick to it.
擬定讀書計畫並確實執行。
Study with a friend and quiz each other.
和朋友一起讀，互相考問。
Do your best, and then let it go.
盡力而為，然後就放下吧。

title: The Great Wall
s: The Great Wall is thousands of kilometers long.
萬里長城長達數千公里。
It was built over many centuries.
它是經過好幾個世紀建造而成的。
It was used to protect against invaders.
它用來抵禦外來入侵者。
Today, it is one of the most visited places in the world.
如今它是全世界最多人參觀的地方之一。

title: Laughter Is Good for You
s: Laughing can reduce stress and make you feel better.
笑能減輕壓力，讓你心情變好。
It also helps people feel closer to each other.
它也讓人與人之間更親近。
Children laugh many more times a day than adults.
小孩一天笑的次數比大人多得多。
So find something funny today!
所以今天找點好笑的事吧！

title: Recycling in Taiwan
s: Taiwan is one of the world's leaders in recycling.
台灣是全球資源回收的領先者之一。
Garbage trucks play music to tell people they are coming.
垃圾車會播放音樂，告訴大家它來了。
People sort their trash into different types.
人們會把垃圾分成不同類別。
This system has greatly reduced waste.
這套系統大幅減少了垃圾量。

title: Growth Mindset
s: A growth mindset means believing you can improve.
成長型思維就是相信自己能進步。
Instead of saying "I can't," say "I can't yet."
不要說「我做不到」，改說「我還做不到」。
Effort and practice help your brain get stronger.
努力和練習讓你的大腦變得更強。
Your abilities are not fixed.
你的能力不是固定不變的。

title: Winter Break Begins
s: For many students, winter break is starting.
對很多學生來說，寒假開始了。
It's time to rest after a busy semester.
忙碌的學期結束，該休息了。
But try to keep a regular sleep schedule.
不過盡量保持規律的作息。
Balance fun, rest, and a little learning.
在玩樂、休息和一點學習之間取得平衡。

title: Honeybees
s: Honeybees are very important for our food.
蜜蜂對我們的食物非常重要。
They help many fruits and vegetables grow.
牠們幫助許多蔬果生長。
A single bee makes only a little honey in its life.
一隻蜜蜂一生只能釀一點點蜂蜜。
Protecting bees means protecting our food supply.
保護蜜蜂就是保護我們的糧食來源。

title: Cooking at Home
s: Cooking is a useful life skill.
煮飯是很實用的生活技能。
Start with easy dishes like fried rice or eggs.
從炒飯或煎蛋這類簡單料理開始。
Ask an adult to help when using the stove.
使用爐火時請大人協助。
Food tastes better when you make it yourself.
自己做的食物吃起來更美味。

title: How Airplanes Fly
s: Airplanes fly because of the shape of their wings.
飛機能飛是因為機翼的形狀。
Air moves over and under the wings at different speeds.
空氣以不同速度流過機翼上下方。
This creates a force called lift.
這會產生一種叫升力的力量。
Engines push the plane forward so lift can happen.
引擎推動飛機前進，升力才能產生。

title: Spring Cleaning
s: Before the Lunar New Year, families clean their homes.
農曆新年前，家家戶戶會大掃除。
People believe cleaning sweeps away bad luck.
人們相信打掃能掃除霉運。
It's a great chance to give away things you don't use.
這是把不用的東西送出去的好機會。
Help your family and make it fun together.
幫忙家人，一起讓打掃變有趣。

title: The Year of the Goat
s: The coming Lunar New Year is the Year of the Goat.
即將到來的農曆新年是羊年。
The Chinese zodiac has twelve animals.
十二生肖有十二種動物。
People born in this year are said to be gentle and kind.
據說這年出生的人溫和善良。
What is your zodiac animal?
你的生肖是什麼？

title: Red Envelopes
s: During Lunar New Year, adults give children red envelopes.
農曆新年期間，大人會給小孩紅包。
The red color stands for good luck.
紅色代表好運。
Some young people now send digital red envelopes by phone.
現在有些年輕人用手機送電子紅包。
What will you do with your red envelope money?
你的紅包錢要怎麼用？

title: Spring Couplets
s: Families put up spring couplets on their doors.
家家戶戶在門上貼春聯。
They are written on red paper with lucky words.
春聯寫在紅紙上，內容是吉祥話。
A common character is "fu," which means good fortune.
常見的字是「福」，意思是好運。
Some people hang it upside down for luck to "arrive."
有些人把福字倒過來貼，代表「福到」。

title: Trying New Foods
s: Trying new foods can be an adventure.
嘗試新食物可以是一場冒險。
You might discover a new favorite dish.
你可能會發現新的最愛。
Different cultures have very different flavors.
不同文化有截然不同的口味。
Be brave and take just one bite!
勇敢一點，咬一口就好！

title: Hello, February
s: February is the shortest month of the year.
二月是一年中最短的月份。
It usually has twenty-eight days.
它通常只有二十八天。
Every four years, it has twenty-nine days.
每四年它會有二十九天。
That extra day is called a leap day.
多出來的那天叫閏日。

title: Wetlands Are Important
s: Today is World Wetlands Day.
今天是世界濕地日。
Wetlands clean water and prevent floods.
濕地能淨化水質並預防水災。
Many birds stop at wetlands during migration.
許多鳥類遷徙時會在濕地停留。
Taiwan has beautiful wetlands, like Gaomei in Taichung.
台灣有美麗的濕地，例如台中的高美濕地。

title: Lucky Foods
s: Lunar New Year dinner is full of lucky foods.
年夜飯充滿吉祥的菜。
Fish stands for having extra every year.
魚象徵年年有餘。
Long noodles stand for a long life.
長長的麵條象徵長壽。
Dumplings look like old money, so they mean wealth.
水餃形狀像古代錢幣，代表財富。

title: Spring Begins
s: Around this time is Lichun, the start of spring.
大約這個時候是立春，春天的開始。
It is one of the twenty-four solar terms.
它是二十四節氣之一。
Farmers used these terms to plan their work.
農民用節氣來安排農事。
Even today, many people still follow them.
即使在今天，許多人仍然依循節氣。

title: Lunar New Year's Eve
s: Tonight is Lunar New Year's Eve.
今晚是除夕。
Families gather for a big reunion dinner.
家人團聚吃一頓豐盛的團圓飯。
Many people stay up late to welcome the new year.
很多人會熬夜守歲迎接新年。
It is the most important night for many Taiwanese families.
這是許多台灣家庭最重要的一夜。

title: Happy Lunar New Year!
s: Happy Lunar New Year!
新年快樂！
People greet each other with "Gong xi fa cai."
人們互相說「恭喜發財」。
Many visit temples to pray for a good year.
許多人會到廟裡祈求好年。
Wishing you health and happiness this year!
祝你今年健康快樂！

title: Visiting Relatives
s: During the holiday, people visit relatives.
假期中，人們會去拜訪親戚。
Some relatives may ask about your grades.
有些親戚可能會問你的成績。
Smile and answer politely.
微笑並禮貌地回答。
You can ask them about their lives, too.
你也可以問問他們的近況。

title: Visiting Mom's Family
s: On the second day of the new year, many married women visit their parents.
大年初二，許多已婚女性會回娘家。
This tradition is called "hui niang jia."
這個傳統叫做「回娘家」。
It's a time for family to reconnect.
這是家人重新聯繫感情的時刻。
Traditions help us remember where we come from.
傳統幫助我們記得自己從哪裡來。

title: Holiday Traffic
s: Highways are very crowded during the long holiday.
長假期間高速公路非常擁擠。
Many people travel to visit family.
許多人出遠門探親。
Leaving early in the morning can help avoid traffic.
一大早出發有助於避開車潮。
Trains and buses are good choices, too.
搭火車和客運也是不錯的選擇。

title: Managing Your Money
s: Did you get many red envelopes this year?
你今年拿到很多紅包嗎？
Try the "save, spend, share" rule.
試試「存、花、分享」原則。
Save some, spend some, and share some with others.
存一些、花一些、分享一些給別人。
Good money habits start young.
好的理財習慣要從小養成。

title: Back to Routine
s: The long holiday is ending.
長假快結束了。
It can be hard to get back into a routine.
要回到規律作息可能有點難。
Go to bed a little earlier each night.
每晚早一點上床睡覺。
Prepare your school bag the night before.
前一晚就準備好書包。

title: Charles Darwin
s: Charles Darwin was born on February 12, 1809.
達爾文生於 1809 年 2 月 12 日。
He studied how living things change over time.
他研究生物如何隨時間改變。
His trip to the Galápagos Islands inspired his ideas.
他到加拉巴哥群島的旅程啟發了他的想法。
He was curious about everything in nature.
他對大自然的一切都充滿好奇。

title: Radio Day
s: Today is World Radio Day.
今天是世界廣播日。
Radio has connected people for more than a hundred years.
廣播連結人們已經超過一百年。
In disasters, radio can still work when phones don't.
災難時，手機不通，廣播仍能運作。
Podcasts are a modern way of enjoying radio.
Podcast 是享受廣播的現代方式。

title: Valentine's Day
s: Today is Valentine's Day.
今天是情人節。
People give cards, flowers, or chocolate to people they love.
人們送卡片、花或巧克力給所愛的人。
Love includes family and friends, too.
愛也包括家人和朋友。
Tell someone you care about them today.
今天告訴某人你很在乎他。

title: New Semester
s: A new semester is starting soon.
新學期快開始了。
It's a fresh start for everyone.
這是每個人的新開始。
Think about one thing you want to do better.
想想有一件事你想做得更好。
Write it down and keep it on your desk.
把它寫下來，放在書桌上。

title: Kindness Week
s: Small acts of kindness can brighten someone's day.
小小的善舉能照亮別人的一天。
Hold the door for someone.
幫別人扶著門。
Say something nice to a classmate.
對同學說句好話。
Kindness spreads when we share it.
善意會在分享中擴散。

title: Why We Yawn
s: Everyone yawns, even babies before they are born.
每個人都會打哈欠，連還沒出生的寶寶也會。
Yawning may help cool down the brain.
打哈欠可能有助於讓大腦降溫。
Yawning is also contagious.
打哈欠也會傳染。
Did you yawn while reading this?
你讀這篇時打哈欠了嗎？

title: Lanterns Light the Night
s: The Lantern Festival is coming soon.
元宵節快到了。
Cities in Taiwan hold big lantern shows.
台灣各城市會舉辦大型燈會。
Some lanterns are shaped like the zodiac animal of the year.
有些燈籠做成當年生肖的造型。
This year, look for goat-shaped lanterns!
今年找找看羊造型的燈籠！

title: Riddles on Lanterns
s: Guessing lantern riddles is a fun tradition.
猜燈謎是有趣的傳統。
Riddles are written on paper attached to lanterns.
謎題寫在掛在燈籠上的紙上。
People try to guess the answers and win small prizes.
人們試著猜答案，贏得小獎品。
Here's one: What has keys but can't open doors? A piano!
來一題：什麼東西有鍵卻開不了門？鋼琴！

title: The Lantern Festival
s: Today is the Lantern Festival.
今天是元宵節。
It marks the end of the Lunar New Year celebrations.
它代表農曆新年慶祝活動的結束。
People eat sweet rice balls called yuanxiao or tangyuan.
人們會吃元宵或湯圓。
In Pingxi, people release sky lanterns with wishes.
在平溪，人們會施放寫上願望的天燈。

title: Mother Language Day
s: Today is International Mother Language Day.
今天是國際母語日。
Taiwan has many languages, like Mandarin, Taiwanese, Hakka, and Indigenous languages.
台灣有許多語言，例如華語、台語、客語和原住民族語。
Every language carries its own culture.
每一種語言都承載著自己的文化。
Can you say "thank you" in more than one language?
你會用超過一種語言說「謝謝」嗎？

title: Crying in Space
s: Did you know astronauts can't cry normally in space?
你知道太空人在太空中無法正常流淚嗎？
Without gravity, tears don't fall down.
沒有重力，眼淚不會往下掉。
They form a ball of water around the eyes.
它們會在眼睛周圍形成水球。
Space changes many things we take for granted.
太空改變許多我們視為理所當然的事。

title: Be a Good Listener
s: Being a good listener is a powerful skill.
當個好聽眾是很強大的能力。
Look at the person and put your phone away.
看著對方，把手機收起來。
Don't interrupt while they are speaking.
對方說話時不要打斷。
People feel respected when you truly listen.
當你真正傾聽，別人會覺得受尊重。

title: Strawberry Season
s: It's strawberry season in Taiwan.
現在是台灣的草莓季。
Dahu in Miaoli is famous for its strawberry farms.
苗栗大湖以草莓園聞名。
Many families go there to pick strawberries.
許多家庭會去那裡採草莓。
Strawberries are full of vitamin C.
草莓富含維生素 C。

title: The Speed of Light
s: Light is the fastest thing in the universe.
光是宇宙中最快的東西。
It travels about 300,000 kilometers per second.
它每秒大約前進三十萬公里。
Sunlight takes about eight minutes to reach Earth.
陽光大約要八分鐘才能抵達地球。
So the sun you see is eight minutes old!
所以你看到的太陽是八分鐘前的樣子！

title: Peace and Memory
s: Tomorrow begins a long weekend in Taiwan.
明天起台灣有連假。
February 28 is Peace Memorial Day.
二月二十八日是和平紀念日。
It remembers a painful event in Taiwan's history.
它紀念台灣歷史上一段傷痛的事件。
Learning history helps us value peace and human rights.
了解歷史讓我們更珍惜和平與人權。

title: Polar Bears
s: Today is International Polar Bear Day.
今天是國際北極熊日。
Polar bears depend on sea ice to hunt seals.
北極熊依賴海冰來獵捕海豹。
As the Arctic warms, the ice is melting.
隨著北極變暖，海冰正在融化。
Saving energy helps protect their home.
節約能源有助於保護牠們的家。

title: Peace Memorial Day
s: Today is Peace Memorial Day.
今天是和平紀念日。
People remember those who suffered in 1947.
人們紀念 1947 年受難的人們。
Many places hold ceremonies and moments of silence.
許多地方會舉行儀式並默哀。
Peace is something we must protect together.
和平是我們必須共同守護的。

title: Hello, March
s: March brings warmer weather to Taiwan.
三月為台灣帶來較溫暖的天氣。
Flowers begin to bloom across the island.
花朵開始在全島綻放。
It's a great month for outdoor activities.
這是從事戶外活動的好月份。
But spring weather can change quickly, so bring a jacket.
不過春天天氣多變，記得帶外套。

title: Cherry Blossoms
s: Cherry blossoms bloom in Taiwan in early spring.
台灣的櫻花在初春盛開。
Popular spots include Alishan and Yangmingshan.
熱門景點有阿里山和陽明山。
The pink flowers only last a short time.
粉紅色的花朵只開短短一段時間。
They remind us to enjoy the moment.
它們提醒我們要把握當下。

title: World Wildlife Day
s: Today is World Wildlife Day.
今天是世界野生動植物日。
Taiwan is home to the Formosan black bear.
台灣是台灣黑熊的家。
It has a white V-shaped mark on its chest.
牠胸前有白色的 V 字形斑紋。
Protecting forests helps protect these bears.
保護森林就是保護這些黑熊。

title: Typing vs. Writing
s: Most students type more than they write by hand.
大多數學生打字比手寫多。
But writing by hand may help you remember better.
但手寫可能幫助你記得更牢。
It makes your brain process the words more deeply.
它讓大腦更深入處理文字。
Try handwriting your notes for important subjects.
重要科目試著用手寫筆記。

title: Insects Wake Up
s: Around this time is Jingzhe, or "Awakening of Insects."
大約這個時候是驚蟄。
Ancient people believed spring thunder woke up insects.
古人相信春雷會喚醒昆蟲。
Farmers began preparing their fields.
農民開始整理田地。
Nature is waking up after winter.
大自然在冬天後甦醒了。

title: Girls in Science
s: Marie Curie was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize.
居禮夫人是第一位獲得諾貝爾獎的女性。
She won two Nobel Prizes in different sciences.
她在不同科學領域獲得兩座諾貝爾獎。
Today, more girls are choosing careers in science.
如今越來越多女孩選擇科學相關職業。
Science needs everyone's ideas.
科學需要每個人的想法。

title: Spring Allergies
s: Some people sneeze a lot in spring.
有些人春天會一直打噴嚏。
This is often caused by pollen in the air.
這通常是空氣中的花粉造成的。
Washing your face after going outside can help.
外出回來洗臉會有幫助。
See a doctor if your allergies are serious.
過敏嚴重時要看醫生。

title: International Women's Day
s: Today is International Women's Day.
今天是國際婦女節。
It celebrates women's achievements around the world.
它慶祝全世界女性的成就。
It also reminds us that equality is still a goal.
它也提醒我們，平等仍是努力的目標。
Thank the women who inspire you.
感謝那些啟發你的女性。

title: Coral Reefs
s: Coral reefs are called the rainforests of the sea.
珊瑚礁被稱為海洋中的雨林。
Thousands of species live around them.
成千上萬的物種生活在珊瑚礁周圍。
Corals are actually tiny animals, not plants.
珊瑚其實是微小的動物，不是植物。
Warmer oceans can turn corals white and weak.
海水變暖會讓珊瑚白化、變虛弱。

title: Teamwork
s: Great things are rarely done by one person.
偉大的事很少是一個人完成的。
In a team, everyone has different strengths.
在團隊中，每個人都有不同的長處。
Listen to others and share your ideas.
傾聽別人，也分享你的想法。
Together, we can do more than we can alone.
一起合作，我們能做到比獨自一人更多。

title: The Tallest Trees
s: The tallest trees in the world are coast redwoods.
世界上最高的樹是北美紅杉。
Some are over one hundred meters tall.
有些超過一百公尺高。
Taiwan also has giant ancient trees in Alishan.
台灣阿里山也有巨大的神木。
Some of them are more than two thousand years old.
其中有些已經超過兩千歲。

title: Arbor Day
s: Today is Arbor Day in Taiwan.
今天是台灣的植樹節。
Trees give us oxygen, shade, and homes for animals.
樹木為我們提供氧氣、遮蔭和動物的家。
Many schools plant trees on this day.
許多學校會在這天種樹。
Planting one tree is a gift to the future.
種下一棵樹，就是送給未來的禮物。

title: Sleeping Better
s: Going to bed at the same time every night helps.
每晚固定時間上床會有幫助。
A dark, quiet, and cool room is best for sleep.
黑暗、安靜、涼爽的房間最適合睡覺。
Avoid caffeine in the afternoon.
下午避免攝取咖啡因。
Good sleep makes learning easier.
睡得好，學習更輕鬆。

title: Pi Day
s: Today is Pi Day, because the date is 3/14.
今天是圓周率日，因為日期是 3/14。
Pi is about 3.14159, and its digits never end.
圓周率約等於 3.14159，而且數字永無止盡。
It helps us measure circles.
它幫助我們計算圓形。
Some people celebrate by eating pie!
有些人會吃派來慶祝！

title: Consumer Rights Day
s: Today is World Consumer Rights Day.
今天是世界消費者權益日。
Consumers have the right to safe products.
消費者有權獲得安全的產品。
Always keep your receipt after buying something.
買東西後一定要保留收據。
If a product is broken, you can ask for a refund.
如果產品壞了，你可以要求退款。

title: Shark Facts
s: Sharks have lived on Earth for over four hundred million years.
鯊魚已經在地球上生活超過四億年。
That's longer than trees have existed!
這比樹木存在的時間還久！
Most sharks are not dangerous to humans.
大多數鯊魚對人類並不危險。
Humans are actually a much bigger threat to sharks.
其實人類對鯊魚的威脅大得多。

title: Saint Patrick's Day
s: Today is Saint Patrick's Day.
今天是聖派翠克節。
It is a holiday from Ireland.
這是愛爾蘭的節日。
People wear green and join parades.
人們穿綠色衣服、參加遊行。
The shamrock, a small green plant, is its symbol.
酢漿草這種小小的綠色植物是它的象徵。

title: Recess Matters
s: Short breaks help your brain recharge.
短暫休息幫助大腦充電。
Moving your body between classes improves focus.
課間活動身體能提升專注力。
Try stretching or walking during recess.
下課時試著伸展或走走。
Your next class will feel easier.
下一堂課會覺得輕鬆一點。

title: Paper Folding
s: Origami is the art of folding paper.
摺紙是一門摺紙張的藝術。
You can make birds, frogs, and flowers from one sheet.
用一張紙就能摺出鳥、青蛙和花。
Scientists even use origami ideas to design space tools.
科學家甚至用摺紙概念設計太空設備。
Try folding a paper crane today.
今天試著摺一隻紙鶴吧。

title: Happiness Day
s: Today is the International Day of Happiness.
今天是國際幸福日。
Happiness often comes from simple things.
幸福常常來自簡單的事物。
Good friends, a nice meal, or a sunny day can do it.
好朋友、一頓好飯或晴朗的一天都可以。
What made you smile today?
今天什麼事讓你笑了？

title: Spring Equinox
s: Around this time is the spring equinox.
大約這個時候是春分。
Day and night are almost the same length.
白天和夜晚幾乎一樣長。
After today, days get longer than nights.
從今天起，白天會比夜晚長。
It's a good time to start something new.
這是開始新事物的好時機。

title: World Water Day
s: Today is World Water Day.
今天是世界水資源日。
Millions of people still don't have clean water.
仍有數百萬人沒有乾淨的水。
Taking shorter showers can save a lot of water.
縮短淋浴時間可以省下很多水。
Every drop counts.
每一滴都很重要。

title: World Weather Day
s: Today is World Meteorological Day.
今天是世界氣象日。
Weather forecasters use satellites and computers.
氣象預報員使用衛星和電腦。
Forecasts help people prepare for storms.
天氣預報幫助人們預防暴風雨。
Checking the weather can help you plan your day.
查看天氣能幫你規劃一天。

title: Fighting Disease
s: Today is World Tuberculosis Day.
今天是世界結核病日。
Tuberculosis is a disease that affects the lungs.
結核病是一種影響肺部的疾病。
It can be cured with the right medicine.
用正確的藥物就能治癒。
Covering your cough helps protect others.
咳嗽時遮口能保護他人。

title: Clean Your Desk
s: A messy desk can make it hard to focus.
凌亂的桌面會讓人難以專心。
Keep only what you need for the task.
只留下這項工作需要的東西。
Put away your phone and extra papers.
把手機和多餘的紙張收起來。
A clean space helps create a clear mind.
整潔的空間有助於清晰的思緒。

title: Volcanoes
s: A volcano is an opening in Earth's surface.
火山是地表上的一個開口。
Hot melted rock, called magma, can come out of it.
炙熱的熔岩，也就是岩漿，可能從中噴出。
Taiwan's Datun Mountain area has volcanic hot springs.
台灣大屯山一帶有火山溫泉。
Volcanoes can be both dangerous and beautiful.
火山既危險又美麗。

title: Earth Hour
s: Earth Hour often takes place in late March.
「地球一小時」通常在三月底舉行。
People turn off their lights for one hour.
人們關燈一小時。
It reminds us to save energy.
它提醒我們節約能源。
Could you live without electricity for an hour?
你能沒有電生活一小時嗎？

title: Being Brave
s: Being brave doesn't mean you aren't afraid.
勇敢不代表你不害怕。
It means you do the right thing even when you are scared.
而是即使害怕，也做對的事。
Speaking up in class takes courage.
在課堂上發言需要勇氣。
Every brave step makes the next one easier.
每一個勇敢的步伐，都讓下一步更容易。

title: Youth Day
s: Today is Youth Day in Taiwan.
今天是台灣的青年節。
Young people have the power to shape the future.
年輕人有塑造未來的力量。
Many teens today care about the environment and fairness.
如今許多青少年關心環境和公平。
What kind of future do you want to create?
你想創造什麼樣的未來？

title: Pencils and Pens
s: A single pencil can draw a line about fifty kilometers long.
一支鉛筆可以畫出大約五十公里長的線。
Pencil "lead" is actually made of graphite.
鉛筆的「鉛」其實是石墨做的。
Erasers were once made from bread.
橡皮擦以前曾經用麵包做。
Everyday objects have surprising stories.
日常物品都有令人驚訝的故事。

title: Goodbye, March
s: March is coming to an end.
三月快結束了。
Spring vacation is almost here.
春假快到了。
Have you kept your New Year's goals?
你有實踐新年目標嗎？
It's never too late to start again.
重新開始永遠不嫌晚。

title: April Fools' Day
s: Today is April Fools' Day.
今天是愚人節。
People play harmless jokes on each other.
人們會互開無傷大雅的玩笑。
Good jokes make everyone laugh, including the person fooled.
好的玩笑能讓大家都笑，包括被騙的人。
Be careful what you believe online today!
今天對網路上看到的東西要特別小心！

title: Children's Books
s: Today is International Children's Book Day.
今天是國際兒童圖書日。
Books for children can teach big lessons.
兒童讀物能傳達大道理。
Many adults still love the picture books they read as kids.
許多大人仍喜愛小時候讀的繪本。
Which book did you love most as a child?
你小時候最愛哪本書？

title: Spring Break
s: Spring break is starting.
春假開始了。
Many families travel or visit relatives.
許多家庭會出遊或探親。
Trains and highways will be busy.
火車和高速公路會很擁擠。
Plan ahead and enjoy your time off.
事先規劃，好好享受假期。

title: Children's Day
s: Today is Children's Day in Taiwan.
今天是台灣的兒童節。
It celebrates children and their right to a happy life.
它慶祝兒童，以及他們享有快樂生活的權利。
Many places offer free entry for kids.
許多地方提供兒童免費入場。
Every child deserves love and care.
每個孩子都值得被愛和照顧。

title: Tomb Sweeping Day
s: Today is Tomb Sweeping Day.
今天是清明節。
Families visit and clean the graves of their ancestors.
家人會去掃墓，清理祖先的墳墓。
They offer flowers, food, and prayers.
他們獻上花、食物並祭拜。
Many people also eat spring rolls, called runbing.
許多人也會吃潤餅。

title: Sports for Everyone
s: Today is International Day of Sport for Development and Peace.
今天是國際體育促進發展與和平日。
Sports bring people together across cultures.
運動能跨越文化把人們聚在一起。
They teach teamwork, fairness, and respect.
運動教會我們團隊合作、公平和尊重。
You don't have to be the best to enjoy playing.
不用是最強的，也能享受運動。

title: World Health Day
s: Today is World Health Day.
今天是世界衛生日。
Health means a healthy body and a healthy mind.
健康代表身體和心理都健康。
Eat well, move often, and rest enough.
好好吃、多活動、睡飽。
Talk to someone if you feel stressed.
覺得有壓力時，找人聊聊。

title: Frogs and Rain
s: In spring, frogs start singing after rain.
春天下過雨後，青蛙開始鳴叫。
Male frogs sing to attract a partner.
雄蛙鳴叫是為了吸引伴侶。
Taiwan has more than thirty kinds of frogs.
台灣有三十多種青蛙。
Their health tells us if the environment is clean.
牠們的健康狀況能反映環境是否乾淨。

title: Passwords Matter
s: A strong password keeps your accounts safe.
強密碼能保護你的帳號安全。
Use a long phrase instead of a short word.
用長句子代替短單字。
Don't use the same password for every app.
不要每個 app 都用同一組密碼。
Never share it, even with friends.
絕不要分享，即使是朋友也一樣。

title: Taiwan's Indigenous Peoples
s: Taiwan has sixteen officially recognized Indigenous peoples.
台灣有十六個官方認定的原住民族。
Each group has its own language and traditions.
每個族群都有自己的語言和傳統。
Their music, art, and festivals are a treasure.
他們的音樂、藝術和祭典都是寶藏。
Learning about them helps us understand Taiwan better.
認識他們能幫助我們更了解台灣。

title: Rainbows
s: A rainbow appears when sunlight shines through raindrops.
陽光穿過雨滴時會出現彩虹。
The water splits the light into colors.
水把光分成各種顏色。
You can only see a rainbow with the sun behind you.
只有背對太陽時才看得到彩虹。
Sometimes you can even see a double rainbow!
有時甚至能看到雙彩虹！

title: Into Space
s: On April 12, 1961, Yuri Gagarin flew into space.
1961 年 4 月 12 日，加加林飛上太空。
He was the first human to travel around Earth in space.
他是第一個在太空中環繞地球的人。
His flight lasted about one hundred and eight minutes.
他的飛行持續大約一百零八分鐘。
Today, astronauts live on space stations for months.
如今太空人會在太空站住上好幾個月。

title: Saying No Politely
s: It's OK to say no sometimes.
有時說不是可以的。
You can say, "Thanks for asking, but I can't."
你可以說：「謝謝邀請，但我沒辦法。」
You don't always need to give a long reason.
你不一定需要給很長的理由。
Respecting your own time is important.
尊重自己的時間很重要。

title: Leonardo da Vinci
s: Leonardo da Vinci was a painter and an inventor.
達文西是畫家，也是發明家。
He drew ideas for flying machines centuries ago.
幾百年前他就畫出飛行器的構想。
He filled thousands of pages with notes and sketches.
他用數千頁紙寫滿筆記和素描。
He showed that art and science can work together.
他證明藝術和科學可以相輔相成。

title: Plastic Bags
s: A plastic bag may be used for only a few minutes.
一個塑膠袋可能只被使用幾分鐘。
But it can last hundreds of years in nature.
但它在自然界中可以存在數百年。
Many shops in Taiwan charge for plastic bags.
台灣許多商店的塑膠袋要收費。
Bring your own bag and say no to plastic.
自備購物袋，拒絕塑膠。

title: Learning by Teaching
s: Teaching others is one of the best ways to learn.
教別人是最好的學習方法之一。
When you explain something, you understand it better.
當你解釋一件事時，你會更了解它。
Try explaining today's lesson to a friend.
試著把今天的課解釋給朋友聽。
If you get stuck, you know what to review.
如果卡住了，你就知道該複習什麼。

title: Mazu Pilgrimage
s: Every spring, a big Mazu pilgrimage takes place in Taiwan.
每年春天，台灣會舉行盛大的媽祖遶境。
Mazu is the goddess of the sea.
媽祖是海上的女神。
Thousands of people walk for days to follow her.
成千上萬的人連走好幾天跟隨她。
It is one of Taiwan's biggest religious events.
這是台灣最大的宗教活動之一。

title: Heritage Day
s: Today is International Day for Monuments and Sites.
今天是國際古蹟遺址日。
Old buildings tell stories about the past.
老建築訴說著過去的故事。
Taiwan has many historic temples and forts.
台灣有許多歷史悠久的廟宇和古砲台。
Visit one and imagine life long ago.
去參觀一處，想像很久以前的生活。

title: Bamboo Grows Fast
s: Some bamboo can grow almost one meter in a day.
有些竹子一天可以長將近一公尺。
It is actually a type of grass.
它其實是一種草。
People use bamboo to make furniture and even buildings.
人們用竹子做家具，甚至蓋房子。
Bamboo shoots are a popular food in Taiwan.
竹筍是台灣很受歡迎的食物。

title: Chinese Language Day
s: Today is UN Chinese Language Day.
今天是聯合國中文日。
Chinese is spoken by more than a billion people.
超過十億人說中文。
Taiwan uses traditional Chinese characters.
台灣使用繁體中文字。
Many foreigners come to Taiwan to learn Mandarin.
許多外國人來台灣學華語。

title: Creativity Day
s: Today is World Creativity and Innovation Day.
今天是世界創意與創新日。
Creativity isn't only for artists.
創意不只屬於藝術家。
Solving a problem in a new way is creative, too.
用新方法解決問題也是一種創意。
Try one new idea today.
今天試試一個新點子。

title: Earth Day
s: Today is Earth Day.
今天是世界地球日。
Our planet gives us air, water, and food.
地球給我們空氣、水和食物。
Turn off lights, use less plastic, and walk more.
隨手關燈、少用塑膠、多走路。
Small actions from many people make a big change.
很多人的小行動能帶來大改變。

title: World Book Day
s: Today is World Book and Copyright Day.
今天是世界書籍與版權日。
Books let us travel without leaving home.
書讓我們足不出戶就能旅行。
Visit a library or a bookstore this week.
這週去一趟圖書館或書店吧。
Share a favorite book with a friend.
和朋友分享一本你最愛的書。

title: Elephants Never Forget
s: Elephants have very strong memories.
大象的記憶力非常強。
They can remember friends after many years apart.
分開多年後牠們仍能認出朋友。
They also show care when another elephant is sad.
當同伴難過時，牠們也會表現關心。
They are one of the smartest animals on land.
牠們是陸地上最聰明的動物之一。

title: Malaria and Mosquitoes
s: Today is World Malaria Day.
今天是世界瘧疾日。
Malaria is spread by mosquitoes.
瘧疾是由蚊子傳播的。
In Taiwan, mosquitoes can also spread dengue fever.
在台灣，蚊子也會傳播登革熱。
Empty standing water to stop mosquitoes from breeding.
倒掉積水，防止蚊子孳生。

title: Inventions We Use Daily
s: Many inventions make our lives easier.
許多發明讓生活更便利。
The zipper, the light bulb, and the toothbrush are just a few.
拉鍊、燈泡和牙刷只是其中幾個。
Inventors often start by noticing a problem.
發明家常常從發現問題開始。
What would you like to invent?
你想發明什麼？

title: Being Patient
s: Good things often take time.
好事常常需要時間。
A seed doesn't become a tree overnight.
種子不會一夜之間長成大樹。
Learning English is the same.
學英文也是一樣。
Keep going, and you will see results.
繼續努力，你就會看到成果。

title: Safety at Work
s: Today is World Day for Safety and Health at Work.
今天是世界工作安全衛生日。
Every worker deserves a safe workplace.
每位勞工都應該有安全的工作環境。
Helmets and gloves protect workers from injuries.
安全帽和手套保護工人免於受傷。
Safety rules exist to protect everyone.
安全規定的存在是為了保護每個人。

title: Dance Day
s: Today is International Dance Day.
今天是國際舞蹈日。
Every culture in the world has its own dances.
世界上每種文化都有自己的舞蹈。
Dancing is great exercise and lots of fun.
跳舞是很棒的運動，而且非常有趣。
Put on a song and move your body!
放首歌，動動身體吧！

title: Jazz Day
s: Today is International Jazz Day.
今天是國際爵士樂日。
Jazz began in the United States over a hundred years ago.
爵士樂起源於一百多年前的美國。
Jazz musicians often make up music as they play.
爵士樂手常常邊演奏邊即興創作。
Listen to a jazz song today and see how it feels.
今天聽一首爵士樂，感受一下。

title: Labor Day
s: Today is Labor Day.
今天是勞動節。
It honors workers and their contributions.
它表彰勞工和他們的貢獻。
Think about the people who make your daily life possible.
想想那些讓你日常生活得以運作的人。
Drivers, cleaners, and shop staff all deserve our thanks.
司機、清潔人員和店員都值得我們感謝。

title: Tuna Fish
s: Today is World Tuna Day.
今天是世界鮪魚日。
Tuna can swim faster than seventy kilometers per hour.
鮪魚游速可超過每小時七十公里。
Too much fishing has made some tuna rare.
過度捕撈讓有些鮪魚變得稀少。
Choosing sustainable seafood helps protect the oceans.
選擇永續海鮮有助於保護海洋。

title: Press Freedom
s: Today is World Press Freedom Day.
今天是世界新聞自由日。
Journalists help us know what is happening in the world.
記者幫助我們了解世界上發生的事。
A free press lets people share different opinions.
新聞自由讓人們能分享不同的意見。
Read news from more than one source.
閱讀不只一個來源的新聞。

title: Firefighters Day
s: Today is International Firefighters' Day.
今天是國際消防員日。
Firefighters bravely put out fires and rescue people.
消防員勇敢地滅火、救人。
In Taiwan, you can call 119 for fire or ambulance help.
在台灣，火災或叫救護車可以打 119。
Check that your home has a working smoke alarm.
確認家裡有正常運作的煙霧偵測器。

title: Hand Hygiene Day
s: Today is World Hand Hygiene Day.
今天是世界手部衛生日。
Washing hands is one of the best ways to stop germs.
洗手是阻止病菌最好的方法之一。
Wash for at least twenty seconds with soap.
用肥皂洗至少二十秒。
Humming "Happy Birthday" twice takes about that long.
哼兩遍生日快樂歌大約就是這麼久。

title: Summer Is Coming
s: Around this time is Lixia, the start of summer.
大約這個時候是立夏，夏天的開始。
Temperatures are rising across Taiwan.
全台氣溫逐漸上升。
Wear sunscreen and drink plenty of water.
擦防曬，多喝水。
Plum rain season will begin soon.
梅雨季即將開始。

title: Thank You, Mom
s: Mother's Day is this Sunday.
這個星期天是母親節。
Think about how your mother or caregiver supports you.
想想你的媽媽或照顧者如何支持你。
You don't need to buy an expensive gift.
你不需要買昂貴的禮物。
A card or helping with chores can mean a lot.
一張卡片或幫忙做家事就很有意義。

title: Red Cross Day
s: Today is World Red Cross and Red Crescent Day.
今天是世界紅十字與紅新月日。
The Red Cross helps people during wars and disasters.
紅十字會在戰爭和災難中幫助人們。
Volunteers give first aid, food, and shelter.
志工提供急救、食物和庇護所。
Learning first aid is a skill that can save lives.
學習急救是能救人一命的技能。

title: Happy Mother's Day!
s: Today is Mother's Day.
今天是母親節。
Many families eat together or give carnations.
許多家庭會一起吃飯或送康乃馨。
Carnations are a symbol of a mother's love.
康乃馨象徵母愛。
Say "I love you" or "thank you" to your mom today.
今天對媽媽說聲「我愛你」或「謝謝」。

title: Migratory Birds
s: Many birds fly thousands of kilometers each year.
許多鳥每年飛行數千公里。
They travel to find food and warm weather.
牠們遷徙是為了尋找食物和溫暖的天氣。
Taiwan is an important stop for migrating birds.
台灣是候鳥遷徙的重要中繼站。
Some birds find their way using the stars.
有些鳥靠星星辨認方向。

title: Plum Rain Season
s: May and June bring the plum rain season to Taiwan.
五、六月是台灣的梅雨季。
It rains often for many days in a row.
常常一連下好幾天雨。
The rain fills reservoirs for the summer.
雨水能為夏天蓄滿水庫。
Keep an umbrella in your bag.
在包包裡放一把傘。

title: Nurses Day
s: Today is International Nurses Day.
今天是國際護師節。
It is held on Florence Nightingale's birthday.
這天是南丁格爾的生日。
Nurses care for patients day and night.
護理師日夜照顧病人。
Thank the healthcare workers in your community.
感謝你社區裡的醫護人員。

title: Half a Year of English
s: You have read English passages for half a year!
你已經讀了半年的英文短文！
That's more than seven hundred sentences.
那是超過七百個句子。
Look back at how much you have learned.
回顧一下你學到了多少。
Keep going. Your English is growing every day!
繼續加油，你的英文每天都在進步！
